notes.title: Updates and new game release!
notes.notes:
Hello my friends!

Our latest game Mai: Child of Ages has just been released, check out the game page!



[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3499550/Mai_Child_of_Ages/"][/dynamiclink]

Venture through past and future, exploring Zelda-like dungeons, and uncover the bond that ties Mai to the enigmatic figure who will guide her throughout the adventure, teaching her the mastery of the arcane Uroboro Stone.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29702066/72b53e05a8f0fba9bcdf978c219956ba25e42715.jpg"]

Also new updates for Woodle Tree 3 are coming, so stay tuned!

notes.title: Update 1.95 Available!
notes.notes:
This new update features:

- Camera control! (you can now change the camera distance, let us know if you like how it is now)

- a whole new world! (an underwater world)

- a new item to unlock!

- ...and minor bug fixes.

We hope you'll like the new updates, let us know what you would like to see in the next one! ːwoodleballː
